title: aifullpeople config
description: Documentation reference for .aifullpeople/config.yaml — not enforced by a script (architecture.md §5: reading/editing a small config is model work, not script work). Read this before hand-editing the file.

human_in_the_loop.description: Requires explicit human approval at every stage transition (architecture.md §15) — separate from the 6+1 quality Gates. Default true; set false only to opt into fully autonomous runs (automation/CI).

language.description: Language of all generated prose content (PRD, design, tasks, reports). IDs, JSON keys, and file names stay ASCII/English regardless (architecture.md §10).

methodology.description: Default methodology for NEW features. Never retroactive — each feature locks its own methodology at creation time in state.json (architecture.md §9). Today only "aifullpeople" exists.

primary_language.description: Selects this stack's concrete guidance source (architecture.md §5). By default, the installed Agent Skill named '<primary_language>-pro' under .agents/skills/ (e.g. "go" -> golang-pro), used exactly as it ships. Override the skill name with guidance_skill, or opt out of skills entirely with guidance_source.

guidance_skill.description: Optional. Name of the installed Agent Skill (under .agents/skills/) that supplies this stack's concrete guidance -- error handling, naming, testing, anti-patterns, idioms -- read as-is, never rewritten by the framework. Defaults to '<primary_language>-pro' (e.g. golang-pro for primary_language: go) when omitted. Ignored when guidance_source is "guidelines".

guidance_source.description: Where this stack's concrete guidance comes from. "skill" (default): the '<primary_language>-pro' Agent Skill (or guidance_skill override), used exactly as installed -- see architecture.md §5. "guidelines": a project-authored guidelines/<primary_language>/ directory instead -- fully custom, not shipped by the framework; use for a stack with no *-pro skill installed, or to hand-roll the rules yourself.

guidelines_exclude.description: Optional. Names of the 5 shared root guideline categories to skip loading (solid-principles, anti-patterns, testing, naming-conventions, error-handling) -- these stay stack-agnostic and load by default regardless of guidance_source. Does not affect guidance_skill or a custom guidelines/<primary_language>/.

gates.description: Quality gates (architecture.md §8). compile and tests cannot be disabled — they are the minimum bar for a feature to reach done.

custom.description: Set true only if the project has a Gate 4 custom script (architecture.md §15 open item: exact discovery convention still TBD — document it in context_project.md when configured).

security.description: Proposed 7th gate (govulncheck for Go, etc.) — off by default until confirmed per project.
